dialogues.en: "No doubt about it, sukiyaki is the best."
dialogues.text: "No doubt about it, sukiyaki is the best."

dialogues.jp: やっぱ、この味が１番っしょ。
dialogues.en: There is nothing better than this taste.
dialogues.text: There is nothing better than this taste.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「手堅くきたわね。まあ、すき焼きならあたし
　も文句ないけど」
dialogues.en:
"You sound confident. Well, I don't have anything to
complain about either, because I love sukiyaki."
dialogues.text:
"You sound confident. Well, I don't have anything to
complain about either, because I love sukiyaki."

dialogues.jp: 卵を割りながら、眞子が珍しく同意する。
dialogues.en: Breaking the egg, Mako agrees with me for a change.
dialogues.text: Breaking the egg, Mako agrees with me for a change.

dialogues.jp: 「ほう、珍しく意見が合ったな」
dialogues.en: "Oh, it's unusual that we could see eye to eye."
dialogues.text: "Oh, it's unusual that we could see eye to eye."

dialogues.jp: 俺も器の底で卵を割る。
dialogues.en: I also crack an egg on the bottom of the serving dish.
dialogues.text: I also crack an egg on the bottom of the serving dish.

dialogues.jp: （角とかで割ると、殻が入りやすいからな……）
dialogues.en:
(If you crack an egg on the edge of the dish, some eggshell
might drop into the dish...)
dialogues.text:
(If you crack an egg on the edge of the dish, some eggshell
might drop into the dish...)

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、これからはすき焼きにしますね」
dialogues.en: "Okay then, I will make sukiyaki every day from now on."
dialogues.text: "Okay then, I will make sukiyaki every day from now on."

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩がニッコリと微笑んで、手を合わせる。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai smiles and places her hands together.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai smiles and places her hands together.

dialogues.jp: その笑顔に微妙な不安を感じる。
dialogues.en: I feel slightly uneasy about her smile.
dialogues.text: I feel slightly uneasy about her smile.

dialogues.jp:
きょとんとする萌先輩の顔を見て、つっこんど
いて良かったと心底思う。
dialogues.en:
Seeing Moe-sempai with a vacant look, I really feel that it
was good to mention it.
dialogues.text:
Seeing Moe-sempai with a vacant look, I really feel that it
was good to mention it.

dialogues.jp:
いくら好きでも毎日は飽きるし、材料費もバカ
になるまい。
dialogues.en:
I love sukiyaki, but I'd get tired of eating it if she made
it every day, and it can also cost a ridiculous amount of
money.
dialogues.text:
I love sukiyaki, but I'd get tired of eating it if she made
it every day, and it can also cost a ridiculous amount of
money.

dialogues.jp: とりあえず、未来の平和は守られた……。
dialogues.en: For the time being, future peace is assured...
dialogues.text: For the time being, future peace is assured...

dialogues.jp: 俺はすき焼きが好きなんだ。
